headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑fliers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. Coforge posted the strongest top‑line expansion, while Infosys trimmed its FY guidance. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, but Wipro saw a slight profit dip. AI‑related deals were highlighted across several firms, but concrete AI revenue figures remain limited.

themes.title: AI‑driven deal wins
themes.detail: Multiple firms cited AI‑led pipelines and new deals, boosting revenue growth especially at Coforge, Mphasis and HCLTech.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook, reflecting cautious market expectations.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY, the highest among peers, and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Strong profit growth, 24% operating margin and $3.1 bn AI revenue crossing 10% of total.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 9.1% YoY and net profit fell 1.9% YoY, with no clear guidance uplift.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut to a low 1‑2% range.
